isolation.testingTool: direct shell command execution (`uv run mlx-stack ...`)

steps.action: Run `uv run mlx-stack init --accept-defaults` with isolated MLX_STACK_HOME
steps.expected: Completes non-interactively using balanced intent and default 40% budget; exits 0; config files generated
steps.observed: Exited 0 with no prompt markers; output shows `Budget: 51.2 GB` on 128 GB profile; stack and litellm files generated

steps.action: Run `uv run mlx-stack init --accept-defaults --intent agent-fleet` on fresh isolated home
steps.expected: Command succeeds non-interactively when combined with explicit intent

assertions.title: Stack definition has required top-level fields

steps.expected: schema_version=1, hardware_profile matches profile_id, intent matches selected intent, name=default, created is ISO-8601
steps.observed: All required top-level fields present and valid; hardware_profile matches generated profile.json profile_id

assertions.title: Each tier has required fields with unique ports

steps.action: Inspect stack tiers in generated default.yaml
steps.expected: Every tier has name/model/quant/source/port/vllm_flags; ports unique and not LiteLLM port
steps.observed: All tiers contain required fields; ports 8000/8001/8002 are unique and distinct from LiteLLM port 4000

steps.action: Compare tier vllm_flags in stack YAML against model catalog capabilities
steps.expected: All tiers include continuous_batching/use_paged_cache=true; tool-calling and thinking parsers match catalog requirements
steps.observed: Base flags are true on all tiers; tool-calling tiers have enable_auto_tool_choice + hermes parser; thinking tiers have correct reasoning parser

assertions.title: LiteLLM config valid with correct model list and endpoints

steps.action: Parse generated litellm.yaml and compare entries to stack tiers
steps.expected: One model_list entry per local tier with api_base localhost:tier_port/v1, openai/ model prefix, and api_key=dummy
steps.observed: model_list count matches local tiers and all endpoint/model/api_key fields match expected values

steps.expected: Fallback chain exists and references only local tier names in model_list
steps.observed: Fallbacks present (`standard -> fast`, `fast -> longctx`) and all references are valid local tier names

assertions.title: Recommend tier assignments flow into init stack definition

steps.action: Run `uv run mlx-stack recommend --intent balanced` and capture tier assignments
steps.observed: Recommend returned standard/fast/longctx model assignments successfully

steps.action: Generate stack with `uv run mlx-stack init --accept-defaults` and compare tier models
steps.expected: Tier models in stack default.yaml exactly match recommend assignments for same intent
steps.observed: All three tiers match after normalized model-name comparison
